purpose: Add only exact-role Nigerian evidence found during the follow-up review of the residual role gaps. Generic domain context is not used as an exact-role match.

skills.name: Operate or support guided urban rail services by following routes, signals, communications, passenger-safety procedures and abnormal-operation protocols
skills.limitation: The checked Nigerian source supports rail-operations context; it does not establish the current volume of tram-driver vacancies.

tools.name: Rail signalling, dispatch, radio, route, timetable, rolling-stock and incident-reporting systems

competencies.name: Keep passenger rail movements predictable and safe by coordinating signals, people, equipment and clear escalation

certifications.name: Applicable Nigerian railway operations, signalling, driver or transport-safety pathway
certifications.issuer: Nigerian Railway Corporation, NBTE, recognised institution or approved operator
certifications.limitation: The exact training and authorization depend on the operator, vehicle and operating rules.

regulatory_requirements.name: Rail operations must follow applicable Nigerian railway, occupational-safety, equipment, passenger and emergency requirements

skills.name: Apply physical-science, engineering, data, instrumentation and human-safety knowledge to spaceflight or space-system work
skills.evidence: NASRDA space-science mandate, physical-and-life-sciences work and Nigerian Astronaut Program context
skills.limitation: Nigeria has a documented astronaut-program and space-science context; the source does not establish an active Nigerian astronaut recruitment route.

skills.name: Work rigorously with experiments, mission procedures, simulation, safety constraints and evidence under uncertain or high-risk conditions

tools.name: Space-system instrumentation, satellite and mission data, simulation, remote-sensing, communications and technical-record systems
tools.limitation: The tools depend on whether the pathway is astronaut training, mission operations, research or engineering.

competencies.name: Make careful, safety-led decisions in a multidisciplinary space environment while communicating uncertainty and limits clearly

certifications.name: Relevant Nigerian physical-science, aerospace, engineering, medicine, data or space-research pathway
certifications.issuer: NASRDA, recognised Nigerian institution or applicable international programme
certifications.limitation: This is not a claim that a Nigerian astronaut licence or guaranteed astronaut selection pathway exists.

regulatory_requirements.name: Space activities must follow applicable Nigerian space-activity authorization, safety, spectrum, health, research and international requirements

skills.name: Monitor and control reactor or nuclear-facility systems, interpret instrumentation, follow operating procedures and respond to abnormal conditions
skills.evidence: NNRA Nigerian nuclear-facility and reactor-operator qualification materials
skills.limitation: The evidence supports a Nigerian nuclear regulatory and research-reactor pathway; it does not prove a commercial power-reactor workforce is currently operating.

skills.name: Maintain nuclear safety, radiation protection, precise records, shift handovers and escalation discipline

tools.name: Reactor instrumentation, control-room displays, radiation monitoring, alarms, operating logs, safety systems and approved simulators
tools.evidence: NNRA Nigerian reactor and nuclear-safety context

competencies.name: Keep nuclear operations within approved safety limits and stop or escalate when conditions, evidence or authorization are insufficient

certifications.name: Nuclear operator training, qualification and authorization applicable to the licensed Nigerian facility
certifications.issuer: NNRA, NAEC, approved facility or applicable training body
certifications.evidence: NNRA draft regulations on licensing and qualifications of nuclear power plant operators
certifications.limitation: Qualification is facility- and authorization-dependent; it is not a general certificate for unrelated engineering work.

regulatory_requirements.name: Nuclear work requires applicable NNRA authorization, radiation protection, safety, security, emergency and facility operating controls
